verdict.rationale: Stripe Financial Connections' own webhooks documentation lists events for newly linked accounts, completed balance refreshes, completed transaction refreshes and ownership refreshes, and it covers inactive-account handling through relink. That supports push-based updates instead of polling for the core data types. However, the events signal that a refresh has completed rather than delivering individual new transactions, and nothing in the pack shows the webhooks are signed. missing for 10: evidence of webhook signature verification, a documented explicit event for connection state changes (only implied by the relink/inactive guidance), per-transaction change events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, data changes arrive as signed webhooks — new transactions, balance updates, connection state changes — so my system stays current without polling

citations.quote: Sent when a customer links a new account. If they link multiple accounts, it emits multiple events (one per account).
Sent after a balance refresh is complete.
Sent after a transaction refresh is complete.
Use the relink API to help your user reconnect their inactive account.
